title: Guira (metal scraper)
summary: The guira is a metal scraper like a grater, central to merengue music. The cylinder is punched with rows of small raised burrs and brushed with a stiff metal rake, which gives quick, bright patterns of sound.
howToPlay: Four places are lit: Down and Up strokes of the brush across the metal, Scratch lower down, Knock on the top rim.
The brush crosses the burrs as a stroke sounds and the ones it touches shine.
A ring closes on the place to strike. Keep the strokes quick and even.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: It drives the merengue of the Dominican Republic, where it runs a constant bright pattern above the drum and the accordion.
